text:
lena: Postmortem follow-up for the 2026-03-17 latency cluster - recurring p95/p99 bursts. Need owners, short timelines, and a dashboard change before next customer sync.

omar: Summary: fallback to CPU infer + uneven batching caused p95 spikes across two zones. We saw three similar events in last 28 days. Error budget hit ~2.4% this month.

lena: Immediate asks: (1) short-term guardrails (throttle big batches), (2) dashboard recurrence metric, (3) owner for routing policy.

omar: I'll own throttle safe defaults and a canary rollout. Plan: small PR today, staging canary tomorrow, prod canary in 48h. ETA full roll by 2026-03-28.

sre-bot: Runbook suggestion: Add a "recurrence" tag to incidents and surface related historical breaches in the incident UI.

infra: I'll add a dashboard tile: "p95 recurrence count (24h)" + heatmap by zone. ETA 2026-03-22. Draft alert below:
```
alert: RecurringLatencyWindow
expr: increase(request_latency_p95[24h]) / sum(increase(request_count[24h])) > 0.12
for: 1h
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Sustained p95 recurrence detected"
```
Keep pages low-frequency but actionable.

lena: SLO change? Don't permanently relax. We will: add operational window note on dashboard, enable guardrails, and re-evaluate SLO in 6 weeks after mitigations. If error budget burn >2% next month, escalate to product for SLA discussion.

omar: Actions: - throttle defaults + PR: omar, ETA 2026-03-19 - routing fallback review: lena, ETA 2026-03-24 - recurrence dashboard + alert: infra, ETA 2026-03-22 - incident taxonomy change: infra, ETA 2026-03-20

infra: ack. Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/89

omar: ack  starting canary pipeline now.

lena: I'll track the action items in the postmortem tracker and post a 1-line status every Friday. If anyone misses ETA, tag me and we'll escalate.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled by omar for 3959996000. Notifying oncall schedule.
